global_rules.css_strategy: Use logical properties (e.g., margin-inline-start, padding-inline-end) for all spacing to ensure seamless RTL/LTR switching.
global_rules.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main containers, rounded-xl for inner elements

scale.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-tight

rules.headings: Never use default sans for English headings. Ensure tight tracking.
rules.arabic_legibility: Avoid extreme opacity on Arabic text. Use solid lighter grays (e.g., text-slate-300) rather than text-white/50.
rules.alignment: Left-align in LTR, Right-align in RTL (text-start).

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Control Room Grid (Dense, Data Correlation). Base Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. Gap Strategy: gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.padding: Generous spacing philosophy. p-6 or p-8 inside cards to prevent text collision.

surface_styles.dashboard_cards: Flat background (#0F0F13), 1px subtle border (border-white/5). Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1), border shifts to border-gold/30, subtle gold shadow.
surface_styles.premium_vault: The 'Tracing Beam' look. Deep black card with a glowing gold/amber border. Add a subtle radial gradient in the background (bg-gradient-to-br from-amber-500/10 to-transparent).
surface_styles.header: Crystal Glass. bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-white/10.
surface_styles.inputs: Solid dark bg (bg-[#16161D]), 1px subtle border. Focus: ring-2 ring-gold/50 border-gold.

buttons.primary: bg-gradient-to-r from-amber-400 to-amber-500 text-black font-bold hover:brightness-110 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,184,0,0.4)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/10 text-white hover:border-gold/50 hover:text-gold

shadcn_overrides.tabs: Override h-9 to h-auto. Active tab gets a glowing bottom border (border-b-2 border-gold text-gold).
shadcn_overrides.select: Ensure dropdown menu uses rtl direction correctly. bg-[#0F0F13] border-white/10.
shadcn_overrides.dialog: Glassmorphism overlay (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm). Dialog box uses surface color with subtle gold border.

icons.library: lucide-react for UI, react-icons (FaInstagram, FaTiktok, FaYoutube) for platform icons.
icons.style: Use dual-tone or glowing accent colors for icons.

motion.content_generation: Use a subtle pulsing glow on the output container while generating.

image_urls.description: Dark retro-futuristic texture for premium vault background
Abstract fluid dark/gold gradients for empty states or AI processing overlays

testing.attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid. Examples: data-testid='generate-content-btn', data-testid='platform-tiktok', data-testid='dialect-select'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure standard HTML dir='rtl' is applied dynamically based on language state. Default is 'rtl'.
Install Google Fonts 'Alexandria' and 'Outfit' in index.html or global CSS.
Implement Shadcn UI heavily but override colors to match the Obsidian/Gold theme.
Platform Icons (Insta, TikTok, Shorts) MUST use their real brand colors when active, or a gold glow when in the 'Premium Vault' section.
The 'Secrets Vault' page must look visually distinct from the main generator—darker, more exclusive, utilizing the 'Tracing Beam' border effect.
Use standard Tailwind logical properties (e.g. ps-4, pe-4, ms-2) instead of pl-4, pr-4 to automatically handle LTR/RTL layout switching.
For the hook generator and platform secrets, create a bento grid layout with distinct visual hierarchy.
